name: @reelspan/cli
description: Reelspan from the terminal: publish videos, photos and text to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X, LinkedIn and more; schedule, retry and read analytics. Built for scripts and AI agents too.
author: Anjum Labs <support@reelspan.com>

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/reelspan.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
